## Description
When a timer set is running, display the current step text in large, readable text positioned above or below the timer display. This will make it easier for users to see which step they're currently on without having to look elsewhere on the screen.

## User Story
As a user running a timer set, I want to see the current step name displayed prominently on the screen so I can easily track which step I'm on.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Current step text is displayed in large font size
- [ ] Text is positioned either above or below the main timer display
- [ ] Text updates when the timer advances to the next step
- [ ] Text is visible and readable during timer operation
- [ ] Design is consistent with the app's UI/UX

## Technical Notes
- Consider font size, positioning, and contrast for readability
- Should work across different screen sizes and orientations
